title: Arjuna Vishada Yoga
subtitle: The Distress of Arjuna
translator: Sir Edwin Arnold, The Song Celestial (1885, public domain)
partialNote: First 12 verses shipped. Remaining 35 verses of Chapter 1 will be added in a future update.

verses.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच। धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca । dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ । māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva kim akurvata sañjaya ॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra spake: Ranged thus for battle on the sacred plain — On Kurukshetra — say, Sanjaya! say what wrought my people, and the Pandavas?

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच। दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा। आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्॥
verses.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca । dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanas tadā । ācāryam upasaṅgamya rājā vacanam abravīt ॥
verses.english: Sanjaya: When he beheld the host of Pandavas, Raja Duryodhana to Drona drew, and spake these words:

verses.sanskrit: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्। व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता॥
verses.transliteration: paśyaitāṁ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām ācārya mahatīṁ camūm । vyūḍhāṁ drupada-putreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā ॥
verses.english: 'Ah, Guru! see what a host of the sons of Pandu hath gathered against us — set in proud array by the son of Drupada, thy scholar wise!'

verses.sanskrit: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि। युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः॥
verses.transliteration: atra śūrā maheṣv-āsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi । yuyudhāno virāṭaś ca drupadaś ca mahā-rathaḥ ॥
verses.english: 'Therein stand mighty bowmen, peers in war of Bhima and Arjuna; Yuyudhan, and Drupada, on his great car;'

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्। पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः॥
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣṭaketuś cekitānaḥ kāśirājaś ca vīryavān । purujit kuntibhojaś ca śaibyaś ca nara-puṅgavaḥ ॥
verses.english: 'Dhrishtaket, Chekitan, Kashi's stout lord, Purujit, Kuntibhoj, and Saivya — chiefs of men;'

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्। सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः॥
verses.transliteration: yudhāmanyuś ca vikrānta uttamaujāś ca vīryavān । saubhadro draupadeyāś ca sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ ॥
verses.english: 'Yudhamanyu the bold, Uttamauj the brave; the son of Subhadra and her sons of Draupadi — all great in war.'

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम। नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते॥
verses.transliteration: asmākaṁ tu viśiṣṭā ye tān nibodha dvijottama । nāyakā mama sainyasya saṁjñārthaṁ tān bravīmi te ॥
verses.english: 'But thou, Brahman, of our own host the chiefest hear named, the bravest who their leaders are; their names I tell thee, that thou know them all:'

verses.sanskrit: भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः। अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च॥
verses.transliteration: bhavān bhīṣmaś ca karṇaś ca kṛpaś ca samitiñ-jayaḥ । aśvatthāmā vikarṇaś ca saumadattis tathaiva ca ॥
verses.english: 'Thyself the first, then Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, fierce in fight; Vikarna, Aswatthaman, the son of Somadatt;'

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः। नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
verses.transliteration: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyakta-jīvitāḥ । nānā-śastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśāradāḥ ॥
verses.english: 'And many another lord of life, who for my sake their lives will give, well-armed, and skilled in war's art.'

verses.sanskrit: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्। पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्॥
verses.transliteration: aparyāptaṁ tad asmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam । paryāptaṁ tv idam eteṣāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣitam ॥
verses.english: 'Weakest — meseems — of all our army shows, despite of Bhishma's care, that lessening band; whilst stronger every troop of these, my foes — Bhima their guard.'

verses.sanskrit: अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः। भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि॥
verses.transliteration: ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathā-bhāgam avasthitāḥ । bhīṣmam evābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi ॥
verses.english: 'Now, therefore — at all the gateways of the war ranged in your stations — bid each chief uphold the cause of Bhishma, ay! and Bhishma guard.'

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sañjanayan harṣaṁ kuru-vṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ । siṁha-nādaṁ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān ॥
verses.english: Then, to enhearten him, the elder of the Kurus blew his conch — loud as the lion's roar, and high its sound.
